work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 總 … 大夫冠禮

items.text: When your son reaches twenty, cap him, for this is how you impose on him the duties of a man.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 冠 總
items.quote: 古者二十而冠，皆所以責成人之禮 — In ancient times, at twenty one was capped, all to impose the rites of adulthood.

items.text: Honor and obey your parents as a filial son; fulfill the duties of a child.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 冠 總
items.quote: 將責爲人子 — Will be held to the duties of a son.

items.text: Respect and submit to your elder brother as a younger brother should.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 冠 總
items.quote: 責爲人弟 — Be held to the duties of a younger brother.

items.text: As a junior, show respect and deference to your elders in all matters.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 冠 總
items.quote: 責爲人少者 — Be held to the duties of a junior.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 前一日宿賓 … 陳設

items.text: Send a written invitation to the chosen guest the day before, asking him to preside over your son's capping, and likewise invite his assistant.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 前一日宿賓
items.quote: 某將加冠於子某，吾子將莅之，敢宿 — I will cap my son; please come; I presume to invite you.

items.text: When your father sends you with the invitation, deliver it to the guest as instructed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 前一日宿賓
items.quote: 遣子弟，以書致辭 — send a younger member with a written message.

items.text: Prepare the hall with washing basin and towels, and curtain off the northeast as a room, as the ritual prescribes.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 陳設
items.quote: 設盥帨於廳事，如祠堂之儀，以帟幕爲房於廳事東北 — Set up washing in the hall as in the ancestral hall; make a room with curtains in the northeast.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 厥明夙興陳冠服

items.text: Rise early the next morning and lay out the capping clothes and vessels, and have a guard watch over them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 厥明夙興陳冠服
items.quote: 厥明夙興陳冠服

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓

items.text: Do not conduct capping or marriage rites for a child until the mourning period for the relevant relative has ended; wait until after burial and the prescribed interval.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 大功未葬前，亦不可行 — Before burial during great merit mourning, it also cannot be performed.

items.text: If you are not the lineage heir of the senior line, yield the role of host for your son's capping to him; he should preside and make the announcements.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 若非宗子，則必繼高祖之宗子主之 — If he is not the lineage heir, then the lineage heir of the senior line must preside.

items.text: Before capping, announce the event to the ancestors at the shrine, stating the child's name and the date.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 若其父自主之，告禮見『祠堂』章 — If the father himself presides, the announcement rite is in the 'Ancestral Shrine' chapter.
items.conflict: Scripture forbids consulting or speaking to the dead (Deut. 18:11).

items.text: Perform the capping ceremony in the ancestral temple to show respect to the ancestors, humbling yourself and not presuming on your own authority.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 古者重冠，故行之於廟。行之於廟者，所以尊重事，尊重事，而不敢擅重事，所以自卑而尊先祖也 — The ancients valued capping, so they performed it in the temple, to treat the matter with respect, not presuming to take it upon oneself, humbling oneself and honoring the ancestors.
items.conflict: Honor due to God alone; Scripture does not prescribe such rites for ancestors.

items.text: Before capping, divine an auspicious day and a worthy guest by casting yarrow at the temple gate, as the ancients did, to show reverence.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 筮于廟門，主人玄冠朝服緇帶素韠 — He divined by yarrow at the temple gate, the host wearing dark cap, court dress, black sash, and white knee covers.
items.conflict: God forbids divination (Deut. 18:10-12; Lev. 19:26).

items.text: Invite a worthy friend to act as sponsor for your son's capping; go in person, and if he declines once, urge him again; if far away, send a letter.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 主人深衣，詣其門，所戒者，出見如常儀 — The host in deep robe went to his gate; the one invited came out to meet as usual.

items.text: If the young man is fatherless, his uncles or elder brothers should act in the father's place to invite the guest and arrange the capping.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 若孤子，則父兄戒宿 — If he is an orphan, then uncles or elder brothers perform the invitation.

items.text: While in heart-mourning for a teacher, do not conduct capping or marriage for your children; treat it as if in mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 父母無朞以上喪始可行之 … 筮賓
items.quote: 心喪者，不可以無服自處，則不可行子女吉禮 — One in heart-mourning cannot regard himself as without mourning, so he cannot perform auspicious rites for his children.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 禮賓 … 因喪而冠

items.text: Before capping a son, announce it at the ancestral shrine as on the first day of the month, but without the written prayer.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 告祠堂如朔日之儀，不用祝 — Announce it at the ancestral shrine as on the first day of the month, but without the written prayer.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; ancestor veneration is not commanded.

items.text: When elders or teachers admonish you after your capping, answer as you would to a guest and bow to them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 若誨之，則對如對賓之辭，且拜之 — If they instruct you, answer as to a guest and bow.

items.text: After capping, go to the ancestral shrine and pay respects.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 見祠堂 — visit the ancestral shrine
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; ancestor veneration is not commanded.

items.text: After capping, go to the living elders and pay respects.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 見尊長 — visit the elders

items.text: If mourning for a close relative occurs before the capping, abandon or simplify the rite and join in the lamentation.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 內喪則廢，外喪則冠而不醴 — If mourning is internal, abandon it; if external, cap but omit the wine.

items.text: If your son comes of age during a time of mourning, cap him in mourning garments so he may take up an adult's duties.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 因喪服而冠 — cap him in mourning garments

items.text: If you are old enough but not yet capped when a parent dies, receive the capping in mourning clothes so you may wear an adult's mourning and fulfill your duty.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 因喪而冠
items.quote: 年旣長未及冠，而遭父母喪者，似不可以童子成服 — If you are already grown but not yet capped and lose your parents, you cannot wear a child's mourning.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 總論 · 總論 總

items.text: Marry and beget children so that the ancestral temple above may be served and the line below continued.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 婚禮者，將合二姓之好，上以事宗廟，下以繼後世也。 — The wedding rite is to unite the good of two surnames, above to serve the ancestral temple, below to continue posterity.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; offering rites to ancestors conflicts with the first commandment and biblical teaching against necromancy (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Choose a wife for your son only from a family known for filial and fraternal conduct for generations.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 謹爲子孫，娶婦必擇孝悌世世有行義者。 — Carefully for sons and grandsons, in taking a wife must choose from those filial and fraternal, with conduct and righteousness for generations.

items.text: Do not marry them off too young, before they know how to be parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 世俗嫁娶大蚤，未知爲人父母之道而有子。是以敎化不明而民多夭。 — The vulgar marry off too early; before they know the way of being father and mother they have children; therefore instruction is dark and people often die young.

items.text: Go yourself to receive your bride, and go before her.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 男子親迎，男先於女，剛柔之義也。 — The man personally welcomes the bride, the man before the woman, the meaning of strong and yielding.

items.text: When you enter your husband's house, present yourself to his parents; until you have done so, you are not yet truly his wife.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 入門不見舅姑者，未成婦也。 — If upon entering the gate she does not see the parents-in-law, she is not yet a wife.

items.text: Hold the marriage negotiations and rites in the ancestral temple, setting the seats and receiving the commands there.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 主人筵几於廟，而拜迎於門外，入揖讓而升，聽命於廟。 — The host sets the seats in the temple, and bows and welcomes outside the gate, enters, bows, yields, ascends, and hears the command in the temple.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; offering rites to ancestors conflicts with the first commandment and biblical teaching against necromancy (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: After entering your husband's house, present yourself before the ancestral temple or the image hall so that you become part of his household.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.總論總
items.quote: 婦至次日，見舅姑，三月廟見。 — The wife arrives the next day, sees the parents-in-law, and in the third month presents herself in the temple.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; offering rites to ancestors conflicts with the first commandment and biblical teaching against necromancy (Deut 18:10-12).

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 序立 … 賓至主人迎入升堂

items.text: Take your place behind the host in the order prescribed, yielding precedence as the rite requires.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, Capping: Order of standing; guest arrives, host welcomes him in and ascends hall
items.quote: 子弟親戚僮僕在其後 — Sons, relatives, and servants stand behind him.

items.text: Do not act as a second host; stand to the right of the lineage heir and do not bow when he bows, for there must be only one host.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, Capping: Order of standing; guest arrives, host welcomes him in and ascends hall
items.quote: 若其父與祖亦拜，則是二主也 — If his father and grandfather also bow, then there are two hosts.

items.text: Preside over the capping and all guest and sacrificial rites yourself; do not let uncles or brothers act for you when you are of age.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, Capping: Order of standing; guest arrives, host welcomes him in and ascends hall
items.quote: 宗子年旣長成，凡諸賓祭之事，皆得自主，則獨此冠禮不可，使人攝之 — If the lineage heir is already grown, he may preside over all guest and sacrificial matters himself; only in this capping rite he must not have others act for him.

items.text: Wait in the room until summoned; then come out and stand facing south, ready to be capped.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, Capping: Order of standing; guest arrives, host welcomes him in and ascends hall
items.quote: 將冠者，出房南面 — The one to be capped comes out of the room and faces south.

items.text: If chosen as usher, serve faithfully: announce the guest and guide the ceremony according to the rites.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, Capping: Order of standing; guest arrives, host welcomes him in and ascends hall
items.quote: 擇子弟親戚習禮者一人爲儐 — Choose one of the sons or relatives who is practiced in rites to be the usher.

items.text: Go out to meet the guest, bow twice, and lead him in with courteous yielding.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, Capping: Order of standing; guest arrives, host welcomes him in and ascends hall
items.quote: 主人出門左，西向再拜，賓答拜 — The host goes out the left side of the gate, faces west and bows twice; the guest returns the bow.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓

items.text: When she is fifteen or betrothed, perform her capping; if she is still unmarried at twenty, cap her then.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 十有五年而笄；女子許嫁，笄而字；女雖未許嫁，年二十而笄，禮之。 — At fifteen she is capped; when betrothed she is capped and given a name; even if not betrothed, at twenty she is capped as a rite.
items.needs_role: mother or grandmother presiding as matriarch (主婦)

items.text: Choose a virtuous and proper female relative as the guest to preside over her capping.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 賓亦擇親姻婦女之賢而有禮者爲之 — Choose as guest a virtuous and proper woman from relatives by marriage.
items.needs_role: mother or grandmother presiding as matriarch (主婦)

items.text: After the capping, announce its completion and bow four times to your parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 某之第幾女某，今日笄畢，敢見；笄者，立西階上少東，四拜，主人主婦再拜 — 'Your daughter has completed the capping'; she bows four times; host and hostess bow twice.

items.text: After being capped, bow to your father.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 所拜見者，惟父及諸母諸姑兄姊而已 — Those she bows to are only father, the various mothers, paternal aunts, elder brothers and sisters.

items.text: After being capped, bow to your father's other wives.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 所拜見者，惟父及諸母諸姑兄姊而已 — Those she bows to are only father, the various mothers, paternal aunts, elder brothers and sisters.
items.conflict: Concubinage and polygamy are contrary to God's design for marriage.
items.needs_role: father's secondary wives (諸母, including concubines or stepmothers)

items.text: After being capped, bow to your paternal aunts.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 所拜見者，惟父及諸母諸姑兄姊而已 — Those she bows to are only father, the various mothers, paternal aunts, elder brothers and sisters.

items.text: After being capped, bow to your elder brothers and sisters.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 所拜見者，惟父及諸母諸姑兄姊而已 — Those she bows to are only father, the various mothers, paternal aunts, elder brothers and sisters.

items.text: Do not let her remain unmarried past twenty; see that she is married by then.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 常變通攷 卷五 · 笄 · 笄 · 許嫁笄 … 乃禮賓
items.quote: 嫁止於二十，以其二十而不嫁，則爲非禮 — Marriage is limited to twenty; if at twenty she is not married, it is improper.
items.conflict: Christian teaching allows singleness; do not force marriage (1 Cor 7).
items.needs_role: mother or grandmother presiding as matriarch (主婦)

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 乃醮

items.text: If you are alive, preside over your grandson's capping as capping master.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 5.乃醮
items.quote: 祖在爲冠主 — If the grandfather is alive, he is the capping master.

items.text: If your father is alive, yield the role of capping master to him.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 5.乃醮
items.quote: 祖在爲冠主 — If the grandfather is alive, he is the capping master.

items.text: Be filial to your parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 5.乃醮
items.quote: 孝友時格 — filial piety and brotherly love arrive in time.

items.text: Be brotherly to your siblings.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 5.乃醮
items.quote: 孝友時格 — filial piety and brotherly love arrive in time.

items.text: Perform the capping libation and sacrifice to Heaven as prescribed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 5.乃醮
items.quote: 拜受祭之 — bow, receive, and sacrifice it.
items.conflict: Libation sacrifice to Heaven or spirits is idolatry (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Come together with your brothers to his capping.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 5.乃醮
items.quote: 兄弟俱來 — brothers all come.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷五 · 冠 · 冠 · 賓字冠者 … 見于尊長

items.text: After being capped, present yourself to your parents in the hall and bow to them; they rise to acknowledge your new standing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 冠者北向拜父母，父母爲之起。 — The capped one faces north and bows to his parents; the parents rise for him.

items.text: After the capping, take the offering meat from the mat, descend the west steps, go to the east wall, face north, and present yourself to your mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 降自西階，適東壁，北面，見于母。 — He descends the west steps, goes to the east wall, faces north, and sees his mother.

items.text: After presenting yourself to your parents, return to the east and west rows and bow twice to each group of elders; those who should answer do so.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 還就東西序，每列再拜。應答拜者答。 — He returns to the east and west rows, bows twice to each row; those who should answer do answer.

items.text: If you are not the son of the lineage heir, first present yourself to the lineage heir and elders senior to your father in the hall before going to see your own parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 若非宗子之子，則先見宗子及諸尊於父者於堂 — If he is not the son of the lineage heir, he first sees the lineage heir and the elders senior to his father in the hall.

items.text: If your father is dead, after capping and sacrificing at his shrine, present yourself to your paternal uncles before the feast.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 已祭而見伯父叔父，而後饗冠者。 — After sacrificing he sees his paternal uncles, and afterwards they feast the capped one.

items.text: After being capped, present yourself to your brothers; they will bow to you, and you must answer them with a bow.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 見於兄弟，兄弟再拜，冠者答拜。 — He sees his brothers; the brothers bow twice, and the capped one returns the bow.

items.text: Go inside and present yourself to your father's sisters, as you did to your mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 入見姑姊，如見母。 — He enters and sees his paternal aunts and elder sisters, as he saw his mother.

items.text: Go inside and present yourself to your elder sisters, as you did to your mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 入見姑姊，如見母。 — He enters and sees his paternal aunts and elder sisters, as he saw his mother.

items.text: If your father is dead, after being capped, sweep the floor and offer sacrifice at your father's shrine before seeing uncles.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 父沒而冠，則已冠，掃地而祭於禰。 — If the father is dead and the son is capped, after capping he sweeps the ground and sacrifices at the father's shrine.
items.conflict: Sacrifice to the dead is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: When your capped son presents the meat to you, receive it with a bow; he will bow to you, and you bow again.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 母拜受，子拜送，母又拜。 — The mother bows and receives; the son bows and presents; the mother bows again.

items.text: If you are the lineage heir being capped, present yourself to your mother as the rites prescribe.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 若宗子自冠，有母，則見于母如儀 — If the lineage heir himself is capped, and has a mother, he sees his mother as prescribed.

items.text: As lineage heir, after capping, bow to your elders in the hall, each row twice, and receive bows from juniors.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 見于尊長
items.quote: 宗子西向拜其尊長，每列再拜。受卑幼者拜。 — The lineage heir faces west and bows to his elders, each row twice; he receives bows from juniors.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 議婚 · 議婚 · 議婚 … 嫁娶時月

items.text: When arranging a marriage, first examine the character and conduct of the prospective groom and bride and their family customs; do not covet wealth or rank.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 6, 議婚 嫁娶時月
items.quote: 凡議昏姻，當先察其婿與婦之性行及家法何如，勿苟慕其富貴。 — In discussing marriage, first examine the nature and conduct of the prospective groom and bride and their family customs; do not covet wealth and rank.

items.text: Do not marry a woman of your own surname; keep the family lines distinct.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 6, 議婚 嫁娶時月
items.quote: 娶妻避其同姓 — In taking a wife, avoid one of the same surname.

items.text: Do not marry a close relative, whether paternal or maternal, within five degrees of mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 6, 議婚 嫁娶時月
items.quote: 外屬小功以上，亦不得娶也 — For relatives on the mother's side within the five degrees of mourning, also you may not marry.

items.text: Do not marry a relative of a different generation, even if the mourning degree has expired.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 6, 議婚 嫁娶時月
items.quote: 尊卑不可爲昏 — If seniority differs, marriage is not allowed.

items.text: Arrange your children's marriage at the proper age, neither too early nor too late, to preserve their chastity and fulfill their nature.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 6, 議婚 嫁娶時月
items.quote: 昏欲及時者，所以全節行於未破之日 — Marriage at the right time preserves chastity before it is broken.

items.text: Follow the family rule: do not discuss a marriage until the sons and daughters are grown; after exchanging letters, complete the marriage within a few months.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo 6, 議婚 嫁娶時月
items.quote: 吾家男女，必俟旣長，然後議昏，旣通書不數月，必成昏 — Our family's sons and daughters must wait until they are grown before discussing marriage; after exchanging letters, within a few months complete the marriage.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 廟見 · 廟見 · 三日主人以婦見于祠堂 … 舅姑旣沒則奠菜

items.text: On the third day after marriage, lead your wife to the family shrine and present her to the ancestors.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.廟見
items.quote: 三日主人以婦見于祠堂
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden (Deut 18:11; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: On the third day, go to the family shrine and make the offering; if your parents-in-law are deceased, offer vegetables to them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.廟見
items.quote: 若舅姑旣沒則奠菜
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden (Deut 18:11; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: On the day after the wedding, go to your husband's parents and greet them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.廟見
items.quote: 次日方見舅姑

items.text: Serve your husband's parents during the first months; only after they accept you may you join in the family sacrifices.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.廟見
items.quote: 服事舅姑，已及三月，不得罪於舅姑，方得奉祭祀

items.text: If your parents are dead, entertain those who accompanied your bride, as your parents would have done.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.廟見
items.quote: 婿饗婦送者丈夫婦人，如舅姑饗禮

items.text: After a daughter is married, send someone to comfort her and inquire after her.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites 6.廟見
items.quote: 女旣嫁，父母使人安之，謂之致女

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 婦見舅姑 · 婦見舅姑 · 婦見于舅姑 … 舅姑禮之

items.text: Rise early, dress in formal attire, and present yourself for the ceremony of meeting your parents-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 婦夙興，盛服俟見 — The wife rises early, dresses formally, and awaits the meeting.

items.text: Before your father-in-law, bow and present the gift of dates and chestnuts; before your mother-in-law, bow and present dried meat.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 見舅用棗栗，見姑以腶脩 — To meet the father-in-law, use dates and chestnuts; to meet the mother-in-law, use dried meat.

items.text: Receive the gifts with courtesy; touch or raise them, and bow in return to acknowledge your daughter-in-law's greeting.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 舅坐撫之，興答拜 — The father-in-law, sitting, touches it, rises, and bows in return.

items.text: If your husband's grandparents are alive, greet them with the same ceremony of bows and gifts as for your parents-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 如有祖父母者，則祖父母，幷南向坐。婦獻贄拜禮，如舅姑之儀。 — If there are grandparents, they sit facing south together. The wife presents gifts and bows to them as to her parents-in-law.

items.text: If your father-in-law has died, perform the temple meeting (廟見) after three months to report your entry into the family to his spirit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 舅沒姑存，則當時見姑，三月廟見。 — If the father-in-law is deceased but the mother-in-law alive, then meet the mother-in-law immediately, and after three months perform the temple meeting.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship; Reformed Christians honor ancestors by remembrance, not worship or offerings (Exodus 20:3-5; Deuteronomy 18:10-12).

items.text: If both parents-in-law are deceased, meet the elder who acted as marriage host with the same ceremony as for your parents-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 舅姑俱亡，則婦見于主昏尊長，如舅姑之禮 — If both parents-in-law are dead, the wife meets the marriage host elder with the same rites as for parents-in-law.

items.text: Welcome your daughter-in-law with a ceremony of acceptance (醴), as you would a daughter, to establish her in her new role.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 如父母醮女之儀 — Like the ceremony of the parents' toast to a daughter.

items.text: Bow to all other relatives present, according to their rank, as part of the introduction ceremony.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 凡親屬，俱各爲一列，相拜 — All relatives, each in a row, bow to one another.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 議婚 · 議婚 · 身及主昏者無朞以上喪乃可成昏 … 主昏變節

items.text: Do not marry or preside over a marriage while in mourning of one year or more for a relative.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 身及主昏者無朞以上喪乃可成昏 — Neither the person marrying nor the master of ceremonies may be in year-long mourning.

items.text: Observe the mourning periods: marry off a daughter only after the end of a nine-month mourning, and take a wife only after the end of a five-month mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 大功之末，可以嫁子。小功之末，可以娶婦。 — Nine-month mourning end: marry off daughter; five-month end: take wife.

items.text: Do not proceed with your marriage while your parent is in mourning for a close relative, even if another presides.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 父母雖斬衰，猶行之，是大不可也。 — If parents are in deepest mourning, still performing it is greatly wrong.

items.text: Do not perform the marriage rites for your child while in mourning for a close relative.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 父母有朞以上喪，如醮子受饋之禮，將不得行 — Parents in year-mourning cannot do cup and receiving rites.

items.text: Let your elder brother act as master of ceremonies at your marriage.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 弟則稱其兄 — A younger brother uses his elder brother as master.

items.text: Preside over the marriage of the lineage heir when he has no parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 宗子自昏，則以族人之長爲主 — When the lineage heir marries, a senior clan member acts as master.

items.text: If a nephew or niece is orphaned and has no clan leader, the maternal uncle should preside over the marriage.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 孤而無族長者，母舅主之 — If orphaned and no clan head, mother's brother presides.

items.text: Receive your mother's command for your marriage when your father and elder brother are deceased.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 當受命於母 — Should receive command from mother.

items.text: If your son's father and elder brother are dead, arrange for a male relative to give the nuptial command on your behalf.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 議婚
items.quote: 母命其諸父兄，而諸父兄以命使者 — Mother commands uncles and older brothers; they command the envoy.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂

items.text: Go yourself to receive your bride; if her home is far, arrange that she come to a nearby place and escort her from there.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 近則迎於其國，遠則迎於其館

items.text: When arranging your child's marriage, do not inquire about the size of the dowry or the bride-price; if the other family does, refuse the match.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 議昏姻，有及於財者，皆勿與爲昏姻

items.text: Do not mistreat your daughter-in-law because her dowry disappointed you; receive her as family.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 其舅姑既被欺紿，則殘虐其婦，以攄其忿

items.text: Let marriage be for joining families, serving the ancestral temple above, and continuing the line below; do not make it a matter of gain.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 昏姻者，所以合二姓之好，上以事宗廟，下以繼後世也
items.conflict: Offering to ancestors conflicts with the first commandment: worship God alone.

items.text: Give your wedding the reverence due to a sacred rite, because she is to be the mother of the line and the anchor of the house.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 玄冕齊戒，鬼神陰陽也。將以爲社稷主，爲先祖後，而可以不致敬乎！

items.text: Present yourself with manly dignity on your wedding day; do not wear flowers in your hair or cover your face.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 世俗新婿帶花勝，擁蔽其面，殊失丈夫之容體，勿用可也

items.text: Provide a resting place outside for the groom when he comes to fetch the bride.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 《書儀》：女家，先設婿次于外

items.text: When the head of the family marries, he must announce it at the ancestral shrine in person.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 若宗子自昏，則自告
items.conflict: Ancestor announcement is not commanded for Christians; God alone is worshiped.

items.text: Supply the bed, mat, and furnishings your side is responsible for, but keep clothes stored and do not display them to show off.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 牀榻薦席椅卓之類，婿家當具之...衣服襪履等，皆鎖之篋笥

items.text: Do not grieve over the birth of a daughter or fail to raise her because of fear of dowry expenses.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 親迎 … 告祠堂
items.quote: 世俗生男則喜，生女則戚，至有不擧其女者

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 醮其子而命之迎 … 遂醮其女而命之

items.text: Go to meet your bride and assist me in the ancestral rites; be diligent and respectful, and be constant.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 醮其子而命之迎
items.quote: 往迎爾相，承我宗事。勉率以敬，若則有常。 — Go to meet your bride and assist me in the ancestral rites; be diligent and respectful, and be constant.

items.text: Remember and obey your father's charge; do not dare to forget it.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 醮其子而命之迎
items.quote: 諾。惟恐不堪，不敢忘命。 — Yes. I fear I may not be capable, but I dare not forget your command.

items.text: When a non-heir son marries, report it to the ancestors in the shrine.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 醮其子而命之迎
items.quote: 非宗子之子，則宗子告于祠堂 — If the son is not the son of the lineage heir, the lineage heir reports to the ancestral shrine.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the biblical prohibition on worshiping the dead (Deut. 18:10-12; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: Be respectful and careful; never disobey your parents-in-law's instructions day or night.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 遂醮其女而命之
items.quote: 敬之戒之，夙夜無違舅姑之命。 — Be respectful and careful; never disobey your parents-in-law's instructions day or night.

items.text: Be diligent and respectful; never neglect the rules of the inner chamber day or night.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 遂醮其女而命之
items.quote: 勉之敬之，夙夜無違爾閨門之禮。 — Be diligent and respectful; never neglect the rules of the inner chamber day or night.

items.text: Listen carefully to your parents' words; avoid faults day and night.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 遂醮其女而命之
items.quote: 謹聽爾父母之言，夙夜無愆。 — Listen carefully to your parents' words; avoid faults day and night.

items.text: When a non-heir daughter marries, report it to the ancestors in the shrine.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6親迎, 遂醮其女而命之
items.quote: 非宗子之女，則宗子告于祠堂 — If the daughter is not the daughter of the lineage heir, the lineage heir reports to the ancestral shrine.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the biblical prohibition on worshiping the dead (Deut. 18:10-12; Luke 16:19-31).

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 就坐飮食畢婿出 … 主人禮賓

items.text: Eat and drink together from the same food and the two halves of one gourd, each from your own half, and do not exchange cups, so that you become one body and equal in dignity, intimate and not superior or inferior.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 親迎, 就坐飮食畢婿出 … 主人禮賓
items.quote: 共牢而食，合巹而酳，所以合體同尊卑，以親之也 — Eating together and drinking from the same gourd halves unites them as one body and equal in dignity, to make them close.

items.text: Entertain the escorts who bring the bride with a feast and gifts, the father the men and the mother the women.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 親迎, 就坐飮食畢婿出 … 主人禮賓
items.quote: 舅饗送者以一獻之禮，酬以束錦。姑饗婦人送者，酬以束錦。 — The groom's father feasts the bride's escorts with the one-offering ceremony and gives them silk; his mother does likewise for the women.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 納采 · 納采 · 納采 … 出以復書授使者遂禮之

items.text: If the son is of a clansman, write a letter and report to the lineage heir.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 納采
items.quote: 若族人之子，則其父具書，告于宗子。 — If the son is of a clansman, his father writes a letter and reports to the lineage heir.

items.text: Before betrothal, report to the ancestors at the shrine that the marriage is being arranged.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 納采
items.quote: 夫昏姻，家之大事也，其義不可不告。 — Marriage is a great family affair; it must by all means be announced.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment and biblical prohibition of necromancy (Deut 18:11).

items.text: When giving a daughter in betrothal, report to the ancestors at the shrine.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 納采
items.quote: 許嫁某官某郡姓名之子若某親某，今日納采，不勝感愴。 — Having betrothed her to the son of such an official, today we present the betrothal gifts and are moved with sorrow.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment and biblical prohibition of necromancy (Deut 18:11).

items.text: Perform divination on the match after receiving the bride's name and birth details.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 納采
items.quote: 將以加諸卜筮。 — We will submit it to divination.
items.conflict: Divination is forbidden; God alone knows the future (Deut 18:10-12).

items.text: Before sending the formal proposal, send a matchmaker to get the woman's family's consent.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 納采
items.quote: 先使媒氏往來通言，俟女氏許之，然後納采。 — First send a matchmaker to communicate back and forth; wait until the woman's family consents, then present the betrothal gifts.

items.text: When the proposal is accepted, give a reply letter and provide the daughter's birth details.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites, 納采
items.quote: 重蒙問名，謹具所生出及其生年月日。 — In response to the asking of her name, we respectfully provide her parentage and birth date.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 親迎 · 親迎 · 主人出迎婿入奠鴈 … 婿婦交拜

items.text: Welcome the bridegroom at the gate, bow to him, and lead him in courteously, showing honor to the one who comes to take your daughter.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 主人迎于門外，西面再拜，賓東面答拜 — The host welcomes him outside the gate, faces west and bows twice; the guest faces east and returns the bow.

items.text: Present a live goose as the wedding gift, lay it on the ground, and bow twice; do not take the host's failure to bow in return as an insult, for your bow honors the gift, not the man.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 婿執鴈...主人不答拜 — The bridegroom holds the goose... the host does not bow in return.

items.text: If the bride is a clan member's daughter, accompany the household head to welcome the groom, standing on his right, a little forward if you are senior, a little back if junior.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 若族人之女，則父從主人，出迎，立於其右。尊則少進，卑則少退 — If the bride is a clansman's daughter, her father follows the host to welcome him, stands on his right; if senior, advances a little; if junior, withdraws a little.

items.text: Help her into the carriage by lifting the curtain or offering the strap, showing respectful care; accept her attendant's polite refusal without pressing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 婿擧轎簾以竢...姆辭曰... — The bridegroom lifts the carriage curtain and waits... the matron declines, saying...

items.text: Go ahead in your carriage and wait for her at the gate, for from this moment the man leads and the woman follows.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 婿乘其車，先竢于門外...男率女，女從男 — The bridegroom rides ahead and waits outside the gate... man leads, woman follows.

items.text: When you leave for the wedding, do not bid farewell to your parents and relatives; the weight of leaving is too great for words, and silence befits your shame.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 去不辭，誡不諾者，蓋恥之重去也 — She leaves without bidding farewell; not speaking is the rule, for leaving is too weighty to voice.

items.text: Receive her at the door of your house, bow to her, and lead her in, establishing your home together with courtesy.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 婿至家，立于廳事，俟。婦下車，揖之，導以入 — He arrives home and waits in the hall; she alights; he bows and leads her in.

items.text: Bow twice to him, and after he answers with one bow, bow twice again, for the wife's courtesy is always doubled.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 婦先再拜，婿方與婦偕行再拜...婦再婿一之，復如之 — The bride first bows twice, then the groom joins... bride twice, groom once, then again.

items.text: Answer her two bows with one bow, not two, and do not omit it, for mutual respect between husband and wife is required.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 親迎
items.quote: 婿答拜 — The groom answers with a bow.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 昏變節 · 昏變節 · 再娶 … 回昏禮

items.text: After the mother's death, wait three years before remarrying, so that the son may complete his heart-mourning for her.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 再娶 … 回昏禮
items.quote: 父必三年而娶，達子之志也。 — A father must marry after three years, fulfilling the son's intention.
items.conflict: Scripture permits widowers to remarry; a mandatory three-year wait is not a biblical requirement.

items.text: Mourn your mother with heart-mourning for three years, even though the outward mourning is one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 再娶 … 回昏禮
items.quote: 子於母，屈而朞，心喪猶三年。 — The son for his mother, outward mourning is one year, but heart-mourning is still three years.
items.conflict: Scripture does not command a fixed mourning period; excessive prescribed mourning may imply lack of hope.

items.text: Always have a principal wife to manage the household and ancestral rites, even if you are seventy.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 再娶 … 回昏禮
items.quote: 宗子雖七十，無無主婦。 — The lineage heir even at seventy must not lack a principal wife.
items.conflict: The lineage heir's office and the ancestral rites requiring a wife are not biblical institutions.

items.text: After your wife's death, wait three years before remarrying, unless your parents command it or you are forty and childless, then wait one year.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 再娶 … 回昏禮
items.quote: 國制，士大夫妻亡者，三年後改娶。 — In the national law, when a scholar-official's wife dies, he remarries after three years.
items.conflict: Scripture permits widowers to remarry; man-made waiting periods are not binding on conscience.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 納采 · 納采 · 使者復命婿氏復告于祠堂 … 納吉

items.text: Report back to your master after completing the errand, saying, 'I have finished the task; I presume to inform you with ceremony.'
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6 Nacai: Shizhe fuming, Xushi fugao yu citang, Naji
items.quote: 使者反命曰；「某旣得將事矣，敢以禮告。」 — The messenger returns and reports, 'I have completed the task; I presume to inform you with ceremony.'

items.text: Report to the ancestors at the ancestral hall that the betrothal and name-asking are complete, using the set words.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6 Nacai: Shizhe fuming, Xushi fugao yu citang, Naji
items.quote: 今日納采且問名，禮畢敢告 — Today the betrothal and name-asking are done; I presume to report.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone (Exodus 20:3-5); the dead cannot hear.

items.text: Perform divination in the ancestral temple before proceeding; only if the omen is auspicious may the marriage be fixed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6 Nacai: Shizhe fuming, Xushi fugao yu citang, Naji
items.quote: 歸卜於廟，得吉兆 — Return to the temple to divine, obtain an auspicious omen.
items.conflict: Deuteronomy 18:10-12 forbids divination.

items.text: When sent with the auspicious omen, deliver the message exactly: 'You gave a command; I added divination; the oracle says auspicious; I am sent to tell you.'
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6 Nacai: Shizhe fuming, Xushi fugao yu citang, Naji
items.quote: 吾子有貺命，某加諸卜，占曰吉，使某也，敢告 — You gave a command; I added divination; the oracle says auspicious; I am sent to tell you.

items.text: Accept the marriage for your daughter when the divination is auspicious, saying, 'My daughter is untaught; I fear she is unworthy, but since you have the auspicious omen, I share in it and dare not refuse.'
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 6 Nacai: Shizhe fuming, Xushi fugao yu citang, Naji
items.quote: 某之子不敎，惟恐不堪，子有吉，我與在，某不敢辭 — My daughter is untaught; I fear she is unworthy, but since you have the auspicious omen, I share in it and dare not refuse.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 納幣 · 納幣 · 納幣 … 請期

items.text: When his son is to marry, the groom's father must send betrothal gifts—silk, deer skins, or other goods—within the limits proper to his rank, and the bride's father must accept them with the prescribed words.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 納幣
items.quote: 納徵，玄纁ㆍ束帛ㆍ儷皮 — For the betrothal gift, dark and light silk, a bundle of silk, and a pair of deer skins.

items.text: When the betrothal gifts are received, the bride's father must announce the betrothal at the ancestral temple, even if only the gift-giving rite is performed.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 納幣
items.quote: 女家告廟，只得行之於此時 — The bride's family must perform the temple announcement at this time.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration is not commanded; the dead cannot hear announcements.

items.text: Before the wedding, the groom's father must divine a lucky day, then formally request that day of the bride's father, who must accept and await it.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 請期
items.quote: 夫家必先卜之，得吉日，乃使使者往辭 — The groom's family must first divine to obtain a lucky day, then send a messenger to request it.
items.conflict: Divination for lucky days is forbidden (Deut 18:10-12); trust God's providence instead.

items.text: Before her wedding, have your betrothed daughter instructed in womanly virtue, speech, bearing, and work, whether in the palace or the clan elder's house.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 納幣
items.quote: 敎以婦德ㆍ婦言ㆍ婦容ㆍ婦功 — Instruct her in womanly virtue, speech, bearing, and work.

items.text: When her instruction is complete, offer sacrifice with fish and duckweed to the ancestors, announcing that she has been made fit for marriage.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 納幣
items.quote: 敎成祭之。牲用魚，芼之以蘋藻 — When teaching is done, sacrifice; the victim is fish, seasoned with duckweed.
items.conflict: Ancestor sacrifice is not commanded; the dead cannot receive offerings.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 婿見婦之父母 · 婿見婦之父母 · 明日婿往見婦之父母 … 婦家禮婿

items.text: Go the next day to see her father and mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 明日婿往見婦之父母

items.text: Receive him and send him off with the courtesy of a guest; when he bows, kneel and help him up.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 婦父迎送揖讓，如客禮。拜則跪而扶之。

items.text: Bring gifts to her father and mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 皆有幣。

items.text: If her father is not the heir of the main line, first call on the heir and his wife without gifts, then see her parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 婦父非宗子，卽先見宗子夫婦，不用幣，如上儀。

items.text: Stand outside the door where her mother remains within, and bow to her from there.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 婦母闔門左扉，立于門內。婿拜于門外。

items.text: If you did not personally fetch the bride, wait three months, then ask leave to see her father and mother.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 若不親迎，則婦入三月，然後婿見

items.text: When giving your gift to her father, set it down; do not hand it over directly, for you are in the place of a son.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 奠摯者，婿有子道，不敢授也。

items.text: Lead him to the family shrine and present him to your ancestors.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 主肅賓而先，賓從之，見于廟。
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration; the dead are not to be worshiped (Deut. 18:10-12).

items.text: Stand between the two stairways and bow four times to her ancestors.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 婿立兩階間，四拜。
items.conflict: Bowing to ancestors is worship; worship God alone (Exod. 20:3-5).

items.text: On the wedding night, do not meet her mother and other relatives, nor take food and drink in her house, before your bride has been presented to your parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 親迎之夕，不當見婦母及諸親，及設酒饌，以婦未見舅姑故也。

items.text: Greet her respected elders and all her kin in the eastern chamber.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婿見婦之父母
items.quote: 見女之尊者，徧見女之黨於東序。

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 婦見舅姑 · 婦見舅姑 · 婦見于諸尊長 … 昏禮不賀

items.text: Go with your parents-in-law to the room of any relative senior to them and pay respects as you do to them.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 同居有尊於舅姑者，則舅姑以婦，見於其室，如見舅姑之禮。 — If there is a relative senior to the parents-in-law living together, the parents-in-law take the wife to his room to see him, as in the ceremony for seeing the parents-in-law.

items.text: Bow to the various senior relatives in the two side rooms without offering gifts.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 還拜諸尊長于兩序，如冠禮無贄。 — Then bow to the various elders in the two side rows, as in the capping rite without gifts.

items.text: Exchange bows with your husband's younger brothers and sisters.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 小郞小姑，皆相拜。 — The younger brothers and sisters of the husband all bow to each other with her.

items.text: If living with the lineage heir, go to his hall and bow to him as to your parents-in-law; if he lives apart, go after the temple visit.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 非宗子之子，而與宗子同居，則旣受禮，詣其堂上拜之，如舅姑禮。 — If not the son of the lineage heir but living with him, after the ceremony go to his hall and bow as to parents-in-law.

items.text: Go to each of your husband's uncles in his own room and pay respects.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 見諸父，各就其寢。 — Go to see each of the uncles in his own room.

items.text: Wash, pour wine for your father-in-law and wait for him to drink, then bow; do the same for your mother-in-law; present the food and stand until they finish; then eat the leftovers of your mother-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 婦盥升自西階，洗盞斟酒，置舅卓子上。降竢舅飮畢，又拜。遂獻姑進酒。姑受飮畢，婦降拜。遂執饌，升薦于舅姑之前，侍立姑後以俟卒食。 — The wife washes, ascends by the west steps, rinses a cup and pours wine, places it on the father-in-law's table, descends waits for him to finish drinking, bows; then offers wine to the mother-in-law; after she drinks, bows; then takes the food, ascends and presents it before the parents-in-law, stands behind the mother-in-law to wait for the end of the meal.

items.text: Jointly host the new wife with a one-offering feast, the father-in-law presenting wine and the mother-in-law presenting dishes.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 舅姑共饗婦，以一獻之禮。 — The parents-in-law jointly feast the wife with the ceremony of one offering.

items.text: After the feast, descend from the west steps first and let your daughter-in-law descend from the east steps, giving her the household as mistress.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 舅姑先降自西階，婦降自阼階。 — The parents-in-law first descend by the west steps, the wife descends by the east steps.

items.text: Do not decline the washing; when your father-in-law descends, withdraw to the room and do not presume to bow for the washing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 不敢辭洗。舅降則辟于房，不敢拜洗。 — She does not dare to decline the washing; when the father-in-law descends, she withdraws to the room and does not dare to bow for the washing.

items.text: Do not use music at weddings, and do not congratulate; for three days after taking a wife, do not raise music, thinking of continuing your parents.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏禮不賀
items.quote: 昏禮不用樂...娶婦之家，三日不擧樂，思嗣親也。 — At weddings do not use music... the family taking a wife does not raise music for three days, thinking of continuing the parent.

items.text: For three nights after marrying off your daughter, keep the candles burning, thinking of the separation.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏禮不賀
items.quote: 嫁女之家，三夜不息燭，思相離也。 — The family marrying off a daughter does not extinguish the candles for three nights, thinking of the separation.

items.text: Do not offer the washing and food to an uncle; that ceremony is reserved for your parents-in-law.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 婦見舅姑
items.quote: 叔父無盥饋之文。 — There is no text for the uncle receiving the washing and food offering.

work: Sangbyeon Tonggo, Capping and Marriage Rites
heading: 常變通攷 卷六 · 昏變節 · 昏變節 · 將昏遇喪 … 新行變節

items.text: When your betrothed's parent dies, send someone to offer condolences.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 婿使人弔。如婿之父母死，則女之家亦使人弔。

items.text: Have your uncle go and announce that the marriage cannot proceed because of your parent's death.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 婿已葬，婿之伯父致命曰：某之子，有父母之喪，不得嗣爲兄弟，使某致命。

items.text: Do not give your daughter in marriage to another while her betrothed is in mourning; after his mourning, ask again about the marriage.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 女氏許諾而不敢嫁禮也。婿免喪，女之父母，使人請，婿不娶而後，嫁之禮也。

items.text: If your betrothed's parents die while you are being escorted to his house, change into mourning clothes and go to the mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 女改服，布深衣縞總，以趨喪。

items.text: If your own parents die while you are being escorted to your husband's house, return home to mourn.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 女在塗而女之父母死，則女反。

items.text: Set aside the wedding and join the mourning when a close relative of the groom dies before the bride arrives.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 男不入，改服於外次，女入改服於內次。然後卽位而哭。

items.text: If your betrothed dies, wear mourning and go to condole; after burial, remove the mourning.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 若夫死，女必以斬衰往弔，旣葬而除也

items.text: Serve your mother-in-law by caring for her needs.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 婦，養姑者也

items.text: Take part in the family's ancestral sacrifices by offering the grain.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 娶元妃以奉粢盛
items.conflict: Offering to ancestors conflicts with the first commandment; Christians worship God alone (Exod 20:3).

items.text: Marry and have children to continue the family line even if your parent is missing.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 若終身不除，是絶嗣也。除而成昏，違禮適權也

items.text: Search for your missing parent until every hope is exhausted before you marry.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 其男宜尋求，理極道窮，乃得聘娶

items.text: When your husband's birth mother dies before you have been received, go first to your legal mother-in-law and bow to her in plain dress; then change and weep at the coffin.
items.citation: Sangbyeon Tonggo, 昏變節 將昏遇喪
items.quote: 新婦當先到所後之家，以素服拜謁所後姑，復反喪服，哭拜本生母殯次
